name: transcenlutions
description: Transcenlutions Tay command-room foundation for business-building and controlled autonomous execution.

scripts.test:identity: tsc lib/platform-identity.ts scripts/check-platform-identity.ts --target ES2022 --module commonjs --moduleResolution node --esModuleInterop --skipLibCheck --outDir .identity-test && node .identity-test/scripts/check-platform-identity.js && node -e "require('fs').rmSync('.identity-test',{recursive:true,force:true})"
scripts.test:workspace: node scripts/check-workspace.mjs && node scripts/check-writing-blocks.mjs && node scripts/check-desktop-bridge.mjs
scripts.test:apex: node --test products/funnel-checklist/test.cjs lib/test-apex-payments.cjs lib/test-apex-workflows.cjs lib/test-apex-browser.cjs products/funnel-checklist/test-ui.cjs
scripts.test:workflows: npm run test:apex && python3 -m unittest discover -s tools/apex-flow -p "test_*.py" && python3 -m unittest discover -s integrations/tay-desktop/tests -v && npm run smoke
scripts.security: npm run test:security && npm run security:dependencies && npm run security:secrets
